_what_this_is: The fixed rewrite list for blinding (protocol, Blinding: 'House style removed'). Applied in order by blind.py after the answer is reduced to plain text. Each rule is a Python regular expression and a replacement. A rule may change wording, never what is claimed: a hedge is reworded, not dropped, because M2 scores certainty and a blinding step that removed 'in our reading' would make WHU's answer overstate. Draft, prep round 1, 2026-10-19; frozen with the protocol.

tells._what_this_is: Residual detectors: run AFTER blinding, counted per answer. A tell identifies a system only if its rate differs between systems, so blind.py reports the same counts on the tools' answers as a baseline.

spelling._what_this_is: British to American spelling, applied to every answer whole-word and case-preserving. WHU writes British English and the three tools write American; spelling is the cheapest tell there is.

process._what_this_is: Sentences about how the answer was made are not sampled, for every system (blinding ruling 19 Oct). A sentence matching any pattern is marked not samplable with the pattern's name. Patterns are matched before and after the rewrite rules, so they cover both 'we could not open' and 'it was not possible to open'.
process.unread_source_note: \b(could not|couldn't|cannot|can't|were unable to|was unable to|unable to|not able to|not possible to|has not been possible to)\s+(be\s+)?(open|opened|read|access|accessed|obtain|obtained|reach|reached|retrieve|retrieved|verify|verified)\b|\b(have|has|had) not (read|opened|seen|been able to)\b|\bpaywall(ed)?\b|\bnot held\b|\bwe hold\b|\bthis answer draws on\b|\b(only|just) (the|its) abstract\b|\babstract only\b|\bfull text (was|is|were) (not|un)
process.watch_section: \b(we are watching|we watch|we will watch|what would settle|would settle (it|this|the question))\b
